verdict.rationale: The registered agent service documents per-state annual report reminders that each user can customize, plus multi-state registration identification and a view of due dates and filing status. That covers the annual-report half of the story for states where Harbor is the agent. Nothing in the evidence documents alerts for franchise tax deadlines; Tax Manager's 'track events' is an adjacent feature, not a documented deadline alert. Missing for 10: documented franchise tax deadline alerts, details on alert lead time and delivery channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
